title: Single realized pairing in derived homology
statement: For normalized derived homology tensor V, class comparison J, natural derived global cup mu and its sectionwise global cup diagram, a realized resolution pairing evaluates on the compared input classes to the compared output class, without a normalization hypothesis on the derived map.

source.place: Section 20.31, Lemma 20.31.3 and global specialization; Tag 01DZ for resolution classes

proof.text: Extend the three cycles using J.on_cycles. Apply V.on_cycles to the two integer global-section complexes and identify the image of its tensor cycle with the output cycle by the chain-level tensor-cycle image theorem.

Move inverse augmentations through the natural cup family. Postcompose the supplied cup diagram and apply naturality of the right-derived comparison to identify the resulting morphism with the localized chain map followed by the target comparison.
Naturality of the homology factorization and homology projection gives the localized cycle formula. Combine it with V.natural and the three formulas from J.on_cycles.

proof_origin.place: normalized cycle and comparison diagram calculation
